summary: CRT handler dispatcher by command id (cdecl, arg a1 = command id). Maps ids 2, 15, 21, 22 to static global handler slots (dword_8D41E8, dword_8D41F4, dword_8D41EC, dword_8D41F0) and ids 4, 8, 11 to a TLS-resident handler resolved by linear array search; rejects any other id with -1. Enters the lazy-init critical section, temporarily saves/clears saved-state fields this[0x54] and this[0x58] (the latter set to 140 for id 8), zeroes exception-table entries in 12-byte steps between dword_5E7888 and dword_5E7888 + dword_5E788C for id 8, invokes the selected handler (id 8 with two arguments, others with the command id), restores the saved fields, and always leaves the critical section before returning 0.

local_names.v3: address of the selected static global handler slot (static ids only)
local_names.v4: TLS/array base object (this); dword index 20 is the TLS table pointer, 21/22 are saved-state fields
local_names.v5: zero value written to the cleared slot/field
local_names.v9: saved this[22] value restored after the handler call
local_names.v10: saved this[21] value restored after the handler call
local_names.v11: in-critical-section flag (set for the static/TLS section-guarded path)

operations.description: Validate the command id a1: ids 2, 15, 21 and 22 select the static global handler slots dword_8D41E8, dword_8D41F4, dword_8D41EC and dword_8D41F0 respectively; any other id returns -1.

For ids 4/8/11, retrieve the TLS array via TLSValueRetrievalWithInit() and resolve the handler slot by linear search ArrayOfStructLinearSearchByID_750a(a1, v4[20]) + 8, reading the handler function pointer from that slot (this[20] is the TLS table base at offset 0x50).
Set the in-critical-section flag v11 = 1 and enter the lazy-init critical section via CriticalSectionLazyInitEnter(1).
If the selected handler pointer equals the sentinel value 1, skip dispatch entirely; if it is null, leave the critical section (CritSectLeave(1)) and call sub_589CB5(3u) before continuing.
For ids 4/8/11, save this[21] (offset 0x54) into v10 and clear it; for id 8 additionally save this[22] (offset 0x58) into v9 and set it to 140.
For id 8, walk the exception-table entries from dword_5E7888 up to dword_5E7888 + dword_5E788C in 12-byte steps, writing 0 at this[20] + step - 4 for each entry.
For the static handler ids (2/15/21/22), clear the selected global slot (*v3 = 0) before dispatch.

Leave the critical section if the flag is set (CritSectLeave(1)), then invoke the handler: id 8 calls v2(8, this[22]) with two arguments, all other ids call v2(a1); afterwards restore this[21] = v10, and for id 8 restore this[22] = v9.
Return -1 for invalid command ids and -1 via sub_589CB5(3u) on the null-handler path; return 0 on every success path.
Called by SEHWrapperDispatchingToHandlerFunction (0x00593C9C) and SEHGuardedFunctionPointerCall (0x00593CFD) as the shared CRT command dispatcher.
